name: Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk
summary: PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk operates primarily within the chicken poultry industry. Its comprehensive activities span breeding operations, the cultivation of broiler chickens, managing laying hens for egg production, and the incubation process for hatching chicks. This company commenced operations on April 11, 2008, and is headquartered in Sleman, Indonesia.
